# Genially View

> > Interactive content platform hosting educational games, quizzes, presentations, and guides created with Genially by educators and organizations worldwide.

Genially View is the viewing platform for interactive content created with Genially, featuring gamified learning experiences, educational presentations, step-by-step guides, and multimedia resources across multiple languages. Content spans from educational board games and escape rooms to professional training materials and campaign presentations.

## Key Topics

- Interactive content creation
- Educational games and gamification
- Quiz templates and millionaire-style games
- Board games (Jumanlly, Jumanji)
- Escape rooms and puzzle challenges
- Step-by-step guides (guia-passo-a-passo)
- Didactic mediation
- Multiplayer learning experiences
- Presentation templates
- Spanish and Portuguese educational content
- Visual thinking
- Procurement and acquisition management (Gestão de Aquisições)
- Historical education (Primera Guerra Mundial)
- Language learning (Spanish B2.1, German)
- Social campaigns and human rights

## Interactive Educational Games

- [Quiz millonario](https://view.genially.com/698a642eaeb7f1269aafc5e8/interactive-content-quiz-millonario): Interactive millionaire-style quiz game with gamification features
- [Jumanlly](https://view.genially.com/698a34a8f2c08b32832d6f67/interactive-content-jumanlly): Multiplayer board game template by Cris Palma with virtual dice
- [Misión: El Código de la Nave Perdida](https://view.genially.com/698a43f0767f44a29c60c93e/interactive-content-mision-el-codigo-de-la-nave-perdida): Space-themed math puzzle escape room by JUAN VIDAL featuring Calculus-9
- [JUMANJI 5 y 6](https://view.genially.com/6989ce32c4f0f285f49ecea9/interactive-content-jumanji-5-y-6): English grammar board game for present continuous practice by LUCIA CUADRADO
- [Quiz Bomba Glossari T7](https://view.genially.com/697fa7e874b744fdef6b6945/interactive-content-quiz-bomba-glossari-t7): WWI terminology quiz in Catalan covering Balkans and Belgium by Sira Manrubia

## Educational Presentations

- [B2.1 Unidad 5 Sesión 5](https://view.genially.com/698a605384c0fb31c1af320b/presentation-b21-unidad-5-sesion-5): Spanish B2.1 lesson on gastronomy using Aula Internacional materials
- [Tema 7 Matemáticas](https://view.genially.com/698a563a83e78dab7f351bd4/presentation-tema-7-matematicas): Math lesson on decimals, division, and fractions by Diego Velasco Cervantes
- [KARNEVALSFESTE](https://view.genially.com/696f6b24953484f766767caa/presentation-karnevalsfeste): German carnival traditions presentation covering D-A-CH regions
- [Etapas de la Historia de la Iglesia](https://view.genially.com/698a4a0c28b902d581db7a6c/interactive-content-etapas-de-la-historia-de-la-iglesia): Interactive timeline of Church history stages by Micaela Aguado Peñas
- [Presentación Financiera](https://view.genially.com/698a3e48f9079c5572a15e05/presentation-presentacion-financiera): Spanish consumer protection presentation featuring OMIC and OCU organizations

## Step-by-Step Guides

- [2.1.4 Como aprovar ou retornar com comentários?](https://view.genially.com/698a35c6aeb7f1269a98d725/guide-214-como-aprovar-ou-retornar-com-comentarios): Guide for approval workflows in procurement management by OLP Team
- [2.1.1 Como receber o Plano de Aquisição?](https://view.genially.com/698a363dc648fb7feeca03b1/guide-211-como-receber-o-plano-de-aquisicao): Step-by-step guide for receiving acquisition plans by OLP Team
- [Control diabetes Pequeña](https://view.genially.com/698a24dbaeb7f1269a8d741f/guide-control-diabetes-pequena): Diabetes tracking guide with insulin and glucose monitoring by silviaqs32

## Social Impact and Campaigns

- [Manos unidas 2026](https://view.genially.com/698a4505d2986f9923b5f9ee/interactive-content-manos-unidas-2026): Manos Unidas 2026 campaign on armed conflicts and hunger by Colegio Melchor Cano
- [trabajamos](https://view.genially.com/698a4891a5b4f763e77a9c4e/interactive-content-trabajamos): IES Alfonso XI multimedia presentation on equality and human rights

## Templates and Resources

- [Pepito - Ideas Geniales Intro a Genially](https://view.genially.com/6543c4accc52dc0011691bff/interactive-content-ideas-geniales-intro-a-genially): Interactive idea board classroom activity template by Jesús Peñalver Quiró
- [Isla](https://view.genially.com/698a495eb4c40c0023bc85ff/interactive-content-isla): Interactive menu interface presentation template by PingüiWeb
- [ERKE](https://view.genially.com/698a4c0283e78dab7f308c34/presentation-erke): Visual thinking presentation template by Lucía Giménez Mengual
- [GENIOTIPO](https://view.genially.com/698a47cda5b4f763e77a29c7/interactive-content-geniotipo): Interactive presentation template showcase by Joana Sanchez Loidi
